# filename: fetch_start_end_prices.py
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

etfs = ['VGT', 'MGK', 'VONG']
start_date = '2013-01-01'
end_date = '2023-12-31'

rows = []
for etf in etfs:
    data = yf.download(etf, start=start_date, end=end_date, auto_adjust=True)
    first_day = data.index.min()
    last_day = data.index.max()
    start_price = float(data.loc[first_day, 'Close'])
    end_price = float(data.loc[last_day, 'Close'])
    rows.append({
        'ETF': etf,
        'Start Date': first_day.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        'Start Price (2013)': round(start_price, 2),
        'End Date': last_day.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        'End Price (2023)': round(end_price, 2)
    })

out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(out)
print("\nData source: Yahoo Finance (yfinance, auto_adjust=True)")
```

import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

etfs = ['VGT', 'MGK', 'VONG']
start_date = '2013-01-01'
end_date = '2023-12-31'

rows = []
for etf in etfs:
    data = yf.download(etf, start=start_date, end=end_date, auto_adjust=True)
    data['Year'] = data.index.year
    avg_2013 = float(data[data['Year'] == 2013]['Close'].mean())
    avg_2023 = float(data[data['Year'] == 2023]['Close'].mean())
    rows.append({
        'ETF': etf,
        'Avg Close 2013': round(avg_2013, 2),
        'Avg Close 2023': round(avg_2023, 2)
    })

out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(out)
print("\nData source: Yahoo Finance (yfinance, auto_adjust=True)")
```
